verified_facts.text: The resort is located about an hour from Casablanca Airport in Morocco.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located just an hour from Casablanca Airport, Morocco

verified_facts.text: The resort sprawls across 250 hectares with 7 kilometers of beachside.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sprawling across 250 hectares & adorned with 7 kilometers of pristine beachside, Mazagan Beach & Golf Resort is a unique, eclectic and vibrant beach destination.

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites overlook the Grand Riad pool, gardens and forest, or the Atlantic Ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: Overlooking the Grand Riad pool, lush gardens and forest, or with sweeping vistas of the deep blue Atlantic Ocean

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites combine Moroccan tradition with contemporary design.
verified_facts.excerpt: Where authentic Moroccan tradition and charm meets stylish contemporary design, each of the hotel’s rooms and suites offers you the complete Mazagan experience.

verified_facts.text: Guests can choose from six distinct room types.
verified_facts.excerpt: Select from six distinct room types, each meticulously crafted to accommodate your preferences

verified_facts.text: Family rooms have views of the gardens, the golf course and the forest.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience the allure of family rooms boasting views of gardens, the golf course, and the forest, tailored for an authentic Moroccan holiday.

verified_facts.text: Ground-floor Patio Family Rooms are available.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ground-floor Patio Family Rooms offer captivating perspectives, ensuring a seamless Moroccan family getaway.

verified_facts.text: The suites offer ample space and ocean views, suited to large families.
verified_facts.excerpt: perfect for those craving elevated comfort, large families, or anyone in pursuit of upscale amenities, all complemented by breathtaking ocean vistas.

verified_facts.text: The concierge can arrange restaurant or spa bookings, activities, and trips to Moroccan cities from Casablanca to Marrakech.
verified_facts.excerpt: be it a restaurant or spa booking, an activity-packed afternoon or a trip to the cities and sights of Morocco from Casablanca to Marrakech and beyond

verified_facts.text: The resort has 15 bars and restaurants.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover a premium selection of 15 signature bars and restaurants.

verified_facts.text: Al Firma serves traditional Moroccan cuisine in a Berber tent, using organic, seasonal ingredients grown in the Al Firma garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: savor the artful presentation of traditional Moroccan cuisine, crafted from organic and seasonal ingredients cultivated in the lush Al Firma garden

verified_facts.text: The Beach Barbecue serves grilled dishes and cocktails on the sand facing the ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: Savor grilled delights, the day's fresh catch, and signature cocktails with your feet in the sand, facing the ocean.

verified_facts.text: Studio 42's decor is inspired by the studios where scenes of the film Casablanca were filmed.
verified_facts.excerpt: the decor is inspired by the studios where the most emblematic scenes of the legendary film “Casablanca” were filmed

verified_facts.text: In July and August, Bushra by Buddha-Bar stages Le Show by Buddha-Bar with fire dancers in its tent-style restaurant.
verified_facts.excerpt: the delightful nights of July and August come alive with the mesmerizing spectacle of Le Show by Buddha-Bar

verified_facts.text: George is a steakhouse with ocean and golf course views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sink your teeth into the highest quality steak, while admiring the breathtaking ocean and golf course views.

verified_facts.text: The Oasis Pool Restaurant and Bar sits at the heart of the resort overlooking the Grand Riad pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulge in the essence of holiday leisure at the heart of our resort, where the Oasis Pool Restaurant and Bar awaits, overlooking the majestic Grand Riad pool.
